issues.description: Initial operational AST harness omitted sys dependency. Positive-control failure exposed this before attack results were accepted. Fixed by supplying standard-library sys; first fixture directory retained. No candidate/helper defect inferred.
Initial manual prior seal hash transcription included adjoining file-count digits. Read actual sealed SHA and validated all209/267 payloads; exact hashes recorded in custody result.
Manually typed derivation timestamp replaced by reference to actual automatic log checkpoint.

Second operational positive control put synthetic gate receipt outside synthetic ROOT. Production relative-path custody correctly rejected it. Fixed fixture layout; retained first two directories. No attack result accepted from either failed harness.
Third harness reached ledger positive control; its mocked gate receipt was relative instead of rooted. Production ledger custody correctly rejected it. Fixed synthetic path; prior fixtures retained.
